item.title: Parks and Recreation — Procurement: Cyber Security Audit
item.description:
Outcome: Procurement
NYC Parks would like to partner with an outside vendor that specializes in a Cyber Security Assessment process and in building security strategies. This strategy will align with OTI s Cyber Command and industry best practices. This assessment will be able to provide NYC Parks direction on our current security vulnerabilities; build a roadmap for improving our overall security posture and strengthen our alignment for the city; and identify and validate weaknesses in the NYC Parks information security architecture and posture from both an internal and external vantage point.
